payload.loadaddr_binding: candidate payload subsection LOADADDR; not carrier base

slack.provenance: c1541 sector-buffer residue (PROFILE, REGION1.BIN, L65INDEX, INIT.L65 after PROFILE) and replace_file-preserved slack (SESSION.BIN shrank by 32 bytes; its old tail equals the current final 32 payload bytes). All slack is derived from fresh payloads.

rule: Templates carry geometry/metadata only; all ELF-derived payload bytes are rederived from the fresh native pair.
